item.title: Four local school districts vote on capital improvement projects
item.description: The State Education Department (SED) allows school districts to undertake major improvements and take advantage of New York State’s Building Aid every five years. SED pays a percentage of capital project costs, typically a majority, with the districts paying the balance known as local share.
